Generates every real independent page from the data manifests under src/data/ (shell.json + sections-core.json + sections-content.json + mock-apps.json — split by domain, see generate-pages.mjs). Runs after sass/esbuild so generated pages can reference the real style.css/script.js paths; the shell template registers the service worker itself (see main.ts) rather than relying on the sw_register injector, since that mod only targets a fixed file list and this project has dozens of generated pages at varying depths. 'manifest' here just anchors the data directory — generate-pages.mjs reads all 4 files from dirname(manifest).
MUST run last — hashes the dist artifacts above to derive BUILD_HASH and inject it into the SW bundle.

wasm._doc: #876 where the pages come from: every constellation-fleet.json row with assets.wasm (a Cloud-<App>.wasm.zip on the rolling release of `repo`) is unzipped by scripts/fetch-wasm.sh into dist/apps/<row label>/, and its tile opens apps/<label>/index.html in an iframe. Refreshed when cloud-u-android's ship-<app>-wasm workflow sends repository_dispatch cloud-web-refresh (ship.yml).

Bake this page's commit history into src/data-generated/commits.json so the Commits panel renders from the bundle instead of calling api.github.com from the visitor's browser, where the unauthenticated 60/hour-per-IP limit meant it almost always showed 'rate limit reached'. MUST run before esbuild, which inlines the JSON. Kept OUT of src/data/ on purpose: that directory is for hand-authored content, every *.json in it gets a PORTAL_DATA wrapper shipped to dist (dead weight here, the JSON is imported directly) and gets consolidated by 1_front-configs. Never fails the build: on a fetch error the previous file is kept.

Generate the full PWA app-icon set from one source image. Idempotent — skips when outputs are newer than source. Re-runs only when public/favicon.jpg changes.

MUST run BEFORE the copy steps that ship qrcode.html + qrcodes.json + the PNGs to dist/.
